title: NF-e Workspace
subtitle: Operational entry point for XML uploads, distribution, and imported invoice review.

upload.title: File intake
upload.subtitle: Send XML and ZIP batches without blocking the rest of the operation.

scheduled.lastRunFailed: The last automatic run, at {{moment}}, failed. No note was received in that cycle.
scheduled.settingsHint: Automatic retrieval is turned on and off in the company settings.

imports.subtitle: Track queue state, totals, and allowed reprocessing.

documents.title: Imported documents

cteEmission.subtitle: Review the fiscal projection before creating the batch. Nothing is transmitted here.
cteEmission.empty: No selected invoice produces a CT-e with the current parameters.
cteEmission.forbidden: You are not allowed to issue CT-es.
